# matcha_saucer — realism QA

Status: **provisional_B_not_certified**. Grades: evidence B, silhouette B, proportions A, colour_texture B, material B, articulation A, physics B, collision A, instances B, cross_view B. Primary visible IoU: 0.761.

Evidence: f0883, f0892, f0403. Camera intrinsics and metric transforms: `../review/calibration.json`. Comparison: `../review/matcha_saucer_compare.jpg`. Per-frame dimensions, IoU, histogram and mask provenance: `../qa_report.json`.

Changes:
- Rebuilt thin radial sheet, foot and cavity-following contact pieces. Refit all three views jointly with the bowl under a shared support normal. Corrected source mask to include the reflected bowl on the metal surface.
- Rebuilt physical mass estimates from constituent density and thin-shell/contact geometry; updated part COM, affine instance mass and material-specific friction.
- Rebuilt reproducible Blender/GLB meshes and collision geometry; preserved instance and review metadata in standalone rebuilds.

Remaining:
- Requested A appearance target for dishware has not been demonstrated.
- Mass, contents, friction, restitution and hidden wall thickness are unmeasured priors.
- Static visible-state evidence does not verify actuation force, thread pitch, seal behavior or fracture. Closed-retention constraints require explicit release actions in a runtime importer.
